QA Tester Summary - Issue #2: API Download Panorama

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/download-panorama.spec.ts (Playwright API request)
Env: Local dev http://127.0.0.1:3007 from branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-2-download-panorama-api.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White download_panorama_route_exists source contains a download panorama API route or handler FN Failed
2 Gray candidate_endpoint_available likely endpoint returns a 2xx implemented response FN Failed
3 Black malformed_request_no_sensitive_leak malformed inputs do not expose local files or internals TN Pass
4 Task Sprint #2 acceptance API Download Panorama is available for consumers FN Failed

Backend Status Code & Review

Flow inferred from issue title: GET/POST /download-panorama or equivalent download panorama endpoint.

Probe Status Response Review
GET /download-panorama 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected
GET /panorama/download 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected
GET /api/download-panorama 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected
POST /download-panorama 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected
POST /panorama/download 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected
POST /api/download-panorama 403 forbidden Failed - endpoint is not implemented/registered as expected

Code Review

  • The issue body is empty, so QA scope was inferred from the issue title only.
  • Static source scan found no route or handler containing download, panorama, or pano under src/.
  • Existing route modules are index, gmb, shorturl, and errorlogs.
  • Current middleware returns 403 forbidden for unrecognized paths before Express can return a normal route-level 404, so missing API endpoints appear as forbidden.

Developer Confirmation

  • Backend developer confirmed the Download Panorama API is deprecated and no longer used.
  • The missing endpoint is therefore treated as obsolete scope, not an active implementation bug.

Bug Notes

  • No active bug after BE confirmation. The issue should be closed or marked as deprecated/out of scope.
  • No sensitive local file or internal config leak was observed from malformed /download-panorama probes.

Verification Commands

npm install
npm install --save-dev @playwright/test
npm run build
node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config=qa-testing/playwright.config.ts

Result

Deprecated / obsolete. The requested API is not present in the current codebase, and BE confirmed it is no longer used.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #3: API Error Log

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/error-log.spec.ts (Playwright API request)
Env: Local dev http://127.0.0.1:3007 from branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-3-error-log-api.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White errorlog_route_contract source registers GET/POST /errorlogs with url/errors validation TP Pass
2 Gray valid_errorlog_flow valid payload stores and list endpoint responds FN Failed
3 Black invalid_payload_rejected missing required fields return 400 validation errors TN Pass
4 Task Sprint #3 acceptance API Error Log works for valid and invalid requests FN + TN Failed

Backend Status Code & Review

Probe Status Response Review
POST /errorlogs valid payload 500 {"statusCode":500,"message":"somthing went wrong"} Failed - valid error log cannot be stored successfully
GET /errorlogs?page=1&size=5 403 forbidden Failed - list request with query params is blocked by middleware
POST /errorlogs empty payload 400 validation error for url Pass
POST /errorlogs empty url/errors 400 validation error for url Pass
POST /errorlogs missing errors 400 validation error for errors Pass

Code Review

  • Issue body is empty, so QA scope is inferred from the issue title.
  • Relevant route: src/routes/errorlogs.ts.
  • Relevant handlers: src/handlers/errorlogs/store.ts, src/handlers/errorlogs/lists.ts.
  • Relevant model: src/models/errorlog.ts.
  • src/middleware/siteChecker.ts only skips the middleware when req.url == '/errorlogs'. With query params, req.url becomes /errorlogs?page=1&size=5, so the request falls through to Google place validation and returns 403 forbidden.
  • src/handlers/errorlogs/store.ts catches create errors and returns a generic 500 message, so the valid create failure is not diagnosable from the API response alone.

Bug Notes

  • Bug 1: GET /errorlogs with query params is blocked by siteChecker, so pagination/search list requests fail with 403 forbidden.
  • Bug 2: valid POST /errorlogs returns 500 somthing went wrong, so the API does not currently accept a normal error-log payload in the tested local environment.
  • Validation behavior for invalid payloads works as expected and returns 400.

Verification Commands

npm run build
node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test qa-testing/specs/api/error-log.spec.ts --config=qa-testing/playwright.config.ts

Result

Failed. The route contract exists, but the valid API flow is not working: create returns 500, and list requests with query params return 403.

issues.display_title: Issue #4: API for Update the Data Exist
issues.main_description_html:
Create API for update the data if the data is exist on the database

QA Tester Summary - Issue #4: API for Update the Data Exist

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/update-existing-data.spec.ts (Playwright API request)
Env: Local dev http://127.0.0.1:3007 from branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-4-update-existing-data-api.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White existing_record_update_contract source has create-or-update branch for /gmb TP Pass
2 Gray create_then_update_same_record first POST creates, second POST updates same place_id + cid Blocked Failed / blocked by DB connection
3 Black invalid_update_payload_rejected missing required fields return 400 validation errors Not run Blocked after server crash
4 Task Sprint #4 acceptance existing database record is updated instead of duplicated Blocked Failed / inconclusive

Backend Status Code & Review

Probe Status Response Review
Static source review Pass POST /gmb has find-existing + update branch Code path exists
POST /gmb create payload Connection reset read ECONNRESET Failed because server process crashed during DB access
WebServer log DB connection error SequelizeConnectionError: connect EACCES 192.168.1.164:3306 Environment/dependency blocker
POST /gmb update payload Not reached Server crashed on create attempt Blocked
GET /gmb/:place_id detail Not reached Server crashed on create attempt Blocked

Code Review

  • Developer description preserved above.
  • Scope inferred as GMB data because src/handlers/gmb/store.ts contains the create-or-update logic.
  • Relevant route: src/routes/gmb.ts.
  • Relevant handler: src/handlers/gmb/store.ts.
  • Relevant model: src/models/gmb.ts.
  • White-box review confirms the intended implementation exists: POST /gmb validates required fields, calls Gmb.findOne({ where: { place_id, cid } }), updates existing records with Gmb.update(...), and creates missing records with Gmb.create(...).
  • Runtime verification could not complete because the local app cannot connect to configured MySQL host 192.168.1.164:3306.
  • The Gmb.findOne(...) call is awaited without a surrounding catch, so the DB connection error terminates the request/server path and Playwright receives ECONNRESET.

Bug Notes

  • Bug 1: API dependency is not reachable on the required MySQL TCP port. The host can be reachable by ping, but the application still fails to connect to 192.168.1.164:3306 with EACCES.
  • Bug 2: POST /gmb crashes/resets the request when DB connection fails. Playwright receives read ECONNRESET instead of a stable JSON API response.
  • Bug 3: Gmb.findOne(...) in src/handlers/gmb/store.ts is awaited before the create/update branch and is not wrapped with error handling, so DB connection errors are not converted into a controlled 500 response.
  • Verification gap: no functional update bug is proven from this run because the database dependency blocks the create/update path before data can be inserted or updated.
  • Follow-up needed with reachable test DB or seeded dev DB to confirm whether duplicate data is prevented and existing data is updated correctly.

Verification Commands

npm run build
node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config=qa-testing/playwright.config.ts --grep "#4"

Result

Failed / inconclusive. The update contract exists in code, but live create-then-update verification is blocked by MySQL connection failure (EACCES 192.168.1.164:3306) and the API connection resets during the request.

QA Tester Summary - Issue #5: API Save Data to Database

Suite: qa-testing/specs/api/save-data-to-database.spec.ts (Playwright API request)
Env: Local dev http://127.0.0.1:3007 from branch qa-testing
Evidence: qa-testing/evidence/logs/issue-5-save-data-to-database-api.json

Test Scenario & Result

# Box Scenario Given -> Expected Matrix Result
1 White gmb_save_route_contract source registers POST /gmb, required validation, and Gmb.create TP Pass
2 Gray valid_gmb_save_flow valid payload returns 201 after saving to DB Blocked Failed / blocked by DB connection
3 Black invalid_save_payload_rejected missing required fields return 400 validation errors Not run Blocked after server crash
4 Task Sprint #5 acceptance API saves valid GMB data to database Blocked Failed / inconclusive

Backend Status Code & Review

Probe Status Response Review
Static source review Pass POST /gmb route, validation, model fields, and Gmb.create(...) exist Save contract exists in code
POST /gmb valid payload Connection reset read ECONNRESET Failed because server process crashed during DB access
WebServer log DB connection error SequelizeConnectionError: connect EACCES 192.168.1.164:3306 Environment/dependency blocker
Invalid payload validation Not reached Server crashed on valid save attempt Blocked

Code Review

  • Issue body is empty, so QA scope is inferred from the issue title.
  • Scope inferred as GMB save API because src/handlers/gmb/store.ts contains Gmb.create(...).
  • Relevant route: src/routes/gmb.ts.
  • Relevant handler: src/handlers/gmb/store.ts.
  • Relevant model: src/models/gmb.ts.
  • White-box review confirms the save API exists: POST /gmb validates place_id, cid, place_name, address, lat, and long, then uses Gmb.create(...) when the record does not already exist.
  • Runtime save verification could not complete because the local app cannot connect to configured MySQL host 192.168.1.164:3306.
  • The DB connection error occurs before a structured API response is returned, so Playwright receives ECONNRESET.

Bug Notes

  • Bug 1: API dependency is not reachable on the required MySQL TCP port. The host can be reachable by ping, but the application still fails to connect to 192.168.1.164:3306 with EACCES.
  • Bug 2: POST /gmb crashes/resets the request when DB connection fails. Playwright receives read ECONNRESET instead of a stable JSON API response.
  • Bug 3: Gmb.findOne(...) in src/handlers/gmb/store.ts is awaited before Gmb.create(...) and is not wrapped with error handling, so DB connection errors are not converted into a controlled 500 response.
  • Verification gap: no functional save bug is proven from this run because the database dependency blocks the save path before data can be inserted.
  • Follow-up needed with reachable test DB or seeded dev DB to confirm whether valid GMB data is saved successfully.

Verification Commands

npm run build
node node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js test --config=qa-testing/playwright.config.ts --grep "#5"

Result

Failed / inconclusive. The save contract exists in code, but live save verification is blocked by MySQL connection failure (EACCES 192.168.1.164:3306) and the API connection resets during the request.
